motion.name: remote-focus
motion.value: ViewPropertyAnimator: 140 ms, DecelerateInterpolator(), scale 1.025 for SHOW/APP/SPORT and 1.0 for HERO/COMPACT
motion.purpose: Finite remote focus feedback; ValueAnimator.areAnimatorsEnabled() false applies the state immediately.

native.implementation: Kotlin Android Views and Canvas; Theme.DeviceDefault.NoActionBar for native dialogs
native.units: DESIGN.md px values are 1920-wide design-reference pixels. Geometry scales by widthPixels / 1920f. Text additionally multiplies by resources.configuration.fontScale. They are not CSS pixels or Android dp.
native.fontAliases: Typeface.create(sans-serif or sans-serif-medium, Typeface.NORMAL); no numeric font weight or browser font stack is inferred.
native.previewPolicy: Native-only documentation. No HTML/CSS stand-ins, synthetic tonal ramps, browser previews, or inferred mobile breakpoints are supplied. The component entries describe the actual native primitives; the sidecar does not provide a runnable web rendering.

screenshots.provenance: Actual 1920x1080 captures from the connected TCL Android TV, as recorded in docs/validation.md; generated comps are superseded.

focus.compactRestOutline: None; the shared Discover panel supplies containment.
focus.heroActionOutline: 1.3 reference pixels with colors.hero-action-edge at rest; 2.5 with colors.ivory on focus.

native.reviewScope: Independent ship verdict covers the scored metadata-contrast and native-evidence fixes and inspected regression scope. It is not whole-surface certification. Static-comp gates remain pending.

components.name: Hero and painted action
components.description: LumaCard.Mode.HERO: real feature artwork, lower-left title and provider action, optional published progress; one focusable native View. Hero focus strengthens the action without scaling the feature.

components.name: Show card
components.description: LumaCard.Mode.SHOW: imagery, dark metadata scrim, medium title, muted detail, optional progress. Ivory focus outline and finite scale.

components.name: Shared compact discovery
components.description: Two LumaCard.Mode.COMPACT rows share one Discover panel. Image uses 52% of the row, text follows, summary is two lines. Focus reveals a border without scale.

components.name: App tile
components.description: LumaCard.Mode.APP: installed-app banner or logo on a dark ground, guarded local artwork transformations, label fallback, visible finite-row focus.

components.name: Sports card
components.description: LumaCard.Mode.SPORT: actual broadcast logo or network name, status, title, and event detail. The section identifies ESPN schedules and Opens RBTV+; activation opens the app with channel guidance.

components.name: Top navigation
components.description: Selected Home is an ivory pill. Unselected focused destinations use nav-focused and an ivory border. Search and Settings are authored Canvas icons with inverted focus.

components.name: Utility button
components.description: Focusable native TextView with tonal resting fill; button-focused inverts to pale sage. Used by the alternate rails, utility actions, and footer credits.

components.name: Empty shelf action
components.description: Full-width two-line TextView showing the real empty, permission, or discovery state; native focus changes the ground and border and OK performs the stated next action.

components.name: Search and dialog controls
components.description: Android EditText inside AlertDialog, with native dialog buttons and menu lists. No custom HTML/CSS component or unobserved typography metrics are specified.

narrative.overview:
The owner's direction is dark sage and black, lightweight and attractive, with subtle contrast and colored app logos. The interface feels restrained and cinematic: the dark ground recedes, real artwork supplies the color, and a small number of ivory focus treatments make the next remote action clear from a couch.

This is the built native Android TV system: Kotlin Android Views, Canvas cards, native dialogs, and the device's system sans-serif aliases. C Balanced is the selected home; A Cinema and B Quiet remain available. The provisional Luma identity appears in the footer's About/Credits entry, with no top wordmark or rail monogram.
keyCharacteristics: Sage-black ground, gentle tonal separation, and fine visible card edges.
Actual provider artwork and installed-app marks supply the color.
A clear remote focus state, finite rows, and quiet finite motion.
Native text scaling, readable metadata, and full accessible labels behind visual truncation.

rules.name: The Color-Pop Rule
rules.body: Keep the surrounding interface subdued so real app marks and still imagery carry the color.

rules.name: The Quiet Focus Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces stay still. Focus changes finish in 140 ms with DecelerateInterpolator; SHOW, APP, and SPORT cards scale to 1.025, while HERO and COMPACT remain at 1.0. When Android disables animators, the state changes immediately.

dos: Do preserve the sage-black ground, fine visible card edges, and color-pop app marks.
Do keep remote focus clear through the implemented fill, outline, and finite scale treatments.
Do retain system font scaling, full accessible labels, and honest visual truncation.
Do use actual provider imagery, published progress, and labeled data sources.
Do keep personal history chronological and distinguish discovery and app-opening sports cards.
Do keep Luma branding and credits at the footer and retain A and B as alternatives to selected C.
donts: Don't add a top Luma wordmark or rail monogram.
Don't replace native system sans with the obsolete automated Salsa guess, or flatten fictional comps into the running home.
Don't invent watch progress, episode state, provider availability, or a verified sports stream link.
Don't turn finite app shelves into looping rows or repeat apps to imply more content.
Don't add idle animation, decorative drop shadows, or bright global accent surfaces to this quiet system.
Don't describe the scoped finish verdict as complete functional certification or a passed pixel-fidelity gate.
